title: 07 Video Editing
subtitle: The timeline that comes with a video artboard — Alligators brand
brief: video editing — Michal's triage decision: "Timeline only when a video artboard is selected". Summoning the timeline (it slides out of the artboard, slides back in; ⇧⌘T keeps it open), basic edits (drop, trim, split, move, transitions, titles with motion, captions edited as text, a music bed with beats that steps aside for speech), an AI cut from 12 clips told as a before → after hero, one video in many formats, playback (tap space plays, hold space pans), export, and the edge cases of a busy club project (footage still on someone's Mac, 4K still preparing, co-editing, 40 clips, vertical footage, no sound) — then Advanced. Real Alligators photos are the footage.

artboards.label: 1 · Nothing selected — no timeline
artboards.note: A video artboard shows its length on the label and its poster frame; nothing hints at a missing timeline.

artboards.label: 2 · Select it — the timeline slides out of it
artboards.note: Selecting Hype trailer · Reels raises a compact timeline from its bottom edge, a notch pointing at it; Expand makes it full width.

artboards.label: 3 · Switch, deselect, keep it open — the timeline's rules
artboards.note: A four-step strip (select, switch video, deselect, ⇧⌘T keep open) and the rules once, with Menu › View › Advanced › Keep timeline open ⇧⌘T (CONTRACT §1).

artboards.label: 4 · Drop footage — on the artboard or the timeline
artboards.note: Three clips dragged in: a line on the timeline shows where they land and how much the video grows; the artboard takes them at the end.

artboards.label: 5 · Trim an edge; S splits at the playhead
artboards.note: The video is as long as its clips: trimming Touchdown makes it 0:14; S split Oslava (⌘B still works).

artboards.label: 6 · Drag a clip to move it
artboards.note: A lifted clip and a line show where it lands; its old place closes up.

artboards.label: 7 · Click a join for a transition
artboards.note: The picker opens at the join between Oslava and Logo: today's six transitions, previews play on hover, a length.

artboards.label: 8 · A title with motion; captions from speech
artboards.note: A title gets a motion preset in the inspector; captions from speech land word by word on the text track.

artboards.label: 9 · Edit the talk as text; style the captions
artboards.note: Striking “Ehm…” in the transcript cuts it from the interview; the inspector styles captions (font, highlight, position, words at a time).

artboards.label: 10 · A music bed: beats, lower under speech, volume
artboards.note: Beat marks with a tall one every bar, Snap to the beat, and the music line dipping by itself under the interview.

artboards.label: 11 · 12 clips in, a 0:30 cut out — on the beat
artboards.note: The signature picture: 12 source clips (3 left out, with reasons) flying into 14 beat-snapped shots on Hype instrumental.

artboards.label: 12 · AI watches 12 clips
artboards.note: Progress in words — “Watching 12 clips… 7 done” — and the shots AI liked so far; the timeline says shots land as AI places them.

artboards.label: 13 · Scrub while AI is still cutting
artboards.note: Shot 7 lands on the beat with a spark ring; your playhead scrubs what's placed while AI's edge moves on.

artboards.label: 14 · Done — the cut is on the artboard
artboards.note: Nothing to accept: Undo · Keep going, chips for a change, the three left-out clips named with Use them anyway.

artboards.label: 15 · Change a shot by hand — swap a take
artboards.note: Touchdown 2 offers its other takes, AI's pick marked; a hand edit is just an edit.

artboards.label: 16 · Three formats, one edit
artboards.note: Reels, 16:9 and 1:1 share one cut and keep their own framing; Make an unlinked copy gives one its own cut; safe zones on Reels.

artboards.label: 17 · Re-frame a clip for 9:16 — follow the player
artboards.note: The 9:16 window follows #1 across the wide shot; other formats keep their framing.

artboards.label: 18 · Play in place, loop a range, step frames
artboards.note: Tap space plays (hold space pans); I/O loop; arrows step frames, ⇧ steps seconds.

artboards.label: 19 · Full-screen preview
artboards.note: Present on a video artboard: only the video, a transport bar and a format switch; esc goes back.

artboards.label: 20 · Export — every format at once
artboards.note: One sheet, as 09: Scope (This canvas · 4 artboards), the formats to tick (the unlinked copy left out), Format MP4/GIF/Sound only, 1080p/4K, captions, cloud or this Mac, a size estimate.

artboards.label: 21 · Rendering, done, partly done
artboards.note: Progress as 09 draws it — a ring on the Exports icon in the Share cluster, the Exports panel under it top-right; one done toast (Show in Finder); a partial failure says “Exported 2 of 3” with one Retry.

artboards.label: 22 · Footage not here yet; 4K clips still preparing
artboards.note: A clip on Jonas's Mac says “Waiting for Jonas's Mac”, quietly — Missing + Relink… only when no device has it; 4K .mov files show “3 clips still preparing”.

artboards.label: 23 · Tereza fixes a caption while you trim
artboards.note: Two playheads, Tereza's cursor on the caption she owns while editing; you trim Huddle meanwhile.

artboards.label: 24 · 40 clips — zoom out, fold tracks, jump by marker
artboards.note: A 4:12 match video zoomed out, names hidden, Text and Graphics folded, markers for the big moments.

artboards.label: 25 · A vertical clip on 16:9; a video with no sound
artboards.note: Fill, Fit or Blur behind for a phone clip, asked once at the clip; the empty music track offers music.

artboards.label: 26 · Advanced — frames, curves, the cut as code
artboards.note: Frame-number ruler, keyframes and an easing curve, render settings, the EDL / code — mono only here.
